question: Good morning, and thank you so much for making this tool available. I really appreciate it. I work for a mid-sized recruitment agency and I am currently preparing a technical shortlist for one of our long-standing clients. They care a lot about test automation, so I would like to be precise and not overstate anything. I hope you don't mind a slightly detailed question. In his work on the Cloud Foundry service brokers, what do the end-to-end test applications actually check? Many thanks in advance for your patience and help.
expected: States that the end-to-end test applications check provisioning, deprovisioning and updates. Stays polite and brief, with no sales talk.
